name: ChatGPT Sites
desc: Build and publish a small interactive website from inside ChatGPT.
desc_zh: 在 ChatGPT 里边聊边搭出一个小型交互网站，做完直接发布。
solves: A dashboard or tracker used to mean a repo, a host and a deploy step. You describe it in Work, preview it, and publish to a URL when it looks right.
solves_zh: 想做一块看板或跟踪表，过去等于要仓库、要主机、还要部署。现在在 Work 里描述需求、预览效果，满意了就发布成一个网址。
best_for: You need a live link a team can open, not a screenshot of an idea.
best_for_zh: 你需要一个团队能打开的活链接，而不是一张想法截图。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — ChatGPT release notes, https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-r）。 ChatGPT release notes, entry under the "July 9, 2026" heading, which is when the public beta opened. Business and Enterprise workspaces had it earlier; no first-party date for that earlier access was found. 首次公开日期来源：https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes
